entities.name: Salamander
entities.description: A creature type for tailed, short-nosed small amphibians, mythically linked to fire.

entities.name: Arbomanders
entities.description: Giant amphibians native to Lorwyn's Wanderwine River that can grow a hundred feet long.

entities.name: Wanderwine River
entities.description: River of Lorwyn where arbomanders live.

entities.name: Amphin
entities.description: Lanky, shrewd, partially aquatic humanoid salamander-folk of Shandalar.

entities.name: Gor Muldrak
entities.description: Amphinologist who wrote Cryptohistories about the Amphins.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: Planeswalker shown as a humanoid axolotl in a non-canon Secret Lair.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: Ravnican guild that uses salamander genetic material in experiments and augmentation.

entities.name: Surrakar
entities.description: Zendikari species similar in appearance to the amphin but unrelated.

relations.quote: the Simic have used salamander genetic material for both experiments
